Description
AddStaffDialog

Administrator
User with complete system management privileges.
Attendance
Record of a single member check-in / check-out.
AttendanceController
Implements the "Member Check In" use case (SRS 3.2.3).
AttendanceDAO
Data access object for the attendance table.
AuthenticationController
Implements the AuthenticationController from the SRS class diagram (Figure 6): verifyCredentials, resetPassword, generateSessionToken.
AuthResult
Outcome of an AuthenticationController.login(String, String) attempt.
Booking

BookingController
Implements the "Book Fitness Class" use case (SRS 3.2.4), member side.
BookingDAO
Data access object for the bookings table.
CheckInDialog
Implements the "Member Check In" use case (SRS 3.2.3).
CheckInHistoryDialog
Member "view check-in history" feature (SRS 2.4 Member View).
ClassController
Trainer-side operations for the "Fitness Classes" / "Trainer Scheduling" feature (SRS 2.2).
DashboardFrame
Shared base class for all role-specific dashboards (Admin, Trainer, Receptionist, Member).
DatabaseConnection
Central place that opens JDBC connections to the MySQL database (SRS 2.6: "The system shall use a MySQL relational database" / "JDBC shall provide database connectivity").
DbInitializer
Bootstraps a freshly created database (see db/schema.sql) with a default Administrator account and starter membership tiers, so the application is usable immediately after the schema is loaded.
FitnessClass
A scheduled fitness session taught by a Trainer.
FitnessClassDAO
Data access object for the fitness_classes table.
FitnessClassesDialog
Implements the "Book Fitness Class" use case (SRS 3.2.4), member side.
GymLogoPanel
A simple logo drawn with Graphics2D (a gold badge containing a dumbbell silhouette) instead of an external image asset, so the project doesn't depend on shipping/loading an image file.
LoginFrame
Entry point screen implementing the "Member Login" use case (SRS 3.2.2).
ManageMembersDialog
Shared "Manage Members" feature (used by both Receptionist and Admin dashboards): lists members with their current membership status, and lets staff renew or suspend a membership.
ManageUsersDialog
Admin "Manage Users" / "User Management" feature: list, add, suspend, activate, delete accounts.
Member
A registered gym customer.
MemberDashboard
Member landing screen: profile/membership status, class booking, self check-in, and attendance history (SRS 2.4 Member View).
Membership
Subscription that grants a member access to gym facilities.
MembershipController
Implements the "Register Member" and "Renew/Suspend Membership" use cases (SRS 3.2.1) and membership tier maintenance (SRS 4.4).
MembershipDAO
Data access object for the memberships table.
MembershipPlansDialog
Admin "Membership Plans" feature: view/add/update/delete pricing tiers.
MembershipTier
An admin-configurable membership pricing tier (e.g.
MembershipTierDAO
Data access object for membership_tiers, letting an Administrator change subscription pricing from the Admin Dashboard without a rebuild (SRS 4.4 Maintainability).
MyClassesDialog
Trainer feature: schedule and manage fitness classes.
MyMembershipDialog
Member "check their personal subscription status" feature (SRS 2.3).
PasswordUtil
Secure password hashing utility used across the system so that no user password is ever stored or compared in plaintext (SRS 4.5 Security).
Payment
A transaction made for membership purchase or renewal.
PaymentController
Implements the "Process Membership Payment" use case (SRS 3.2.5).
PaymentDAO
Data access object for the payments table.
PaymentGatewaySimulator
Stand-in for the external "Payment Gateway" actor shown in the SRS use case (Figure 1) and sequence diagram (Figure 4).
PaymentsHistoryDialog
Admin view of all payment transactions logged by the system.
ProcessPaymentDialog
Implements the "Process Membership Payment" use case (SRS 3.2.5).
Receptionist
Staff member responsible for member registration and daily operations.
ReceptionistDashboard
Receptionist landing screen: registration, check-in, and payment processing - the daily front-desk operations described in SRS 2.3.
RegisterMemberDialog
Implements the "Register Member" use case (SRS 3.2.1).
ReportController
Aggregates data for the Admin "Generate Reports" use case (SRS use case diagram).
ReportsDialog
Admin "Generate Reports" feature: operational summary (SRS 2.2, 4.3 performance target 10s).
Result
Generic outcome wrapper returned by controller operations, carrying a success flag, a user-facing message, and an optional generated id (e.g.
Role
The set of access roles supported by the Gym Membership Login System.
RosterDialog
Trainer feature: view registered participants for a selected class.
Trainer
Gym staff member responsible for teaching fitness classes.
TrainerDAO
Data access object for the trainers table, joined with users to build fully-populated Trainer objects.
TrainerDashboard
Trainer landing screen: manage class schedule and view class rosters (SRS 2.2 Trainer Scheduling).
UiTheme
Shared visual identity for the system: a purple brand palette and a clean sans-serif type scale, applied to the Login screen (SRS 4.6 Usability: "a simple, consistent, and intuitive design utilizing a standard color theme").
User
Abstract base class representing any authenticated actor in the system (Administrator, Trainer, Receptionist, or Member), matching the <<Abstract>> User class in the SRS class diagram (Figure 6).
UserDAO
Data access object for the users table, which backs every User subclass (single-table inheritance).
UserManagementController
Admin-only user management (Manage Users use case): create staff accounts (Trainer/Receptionist/Admin), suspend/reactivate, and delete.
